programmes.d: MacGyver's mountain retreat group is infiltrated by a couple of murderous escaped convicts.
MacGyver unravels an assassination plot against an East African leader after discovering that Jack Dalton has been brainwashed.
A spoiled Texas heiress pits a beach boy against a playboy in a bizarre card game. As the rivals vie for the attentions of the Texas rose, Five-O becomes the thorn in her plans.
Ossie Connors, an adversary from McGarrett's past, manages to accomplish the perfect robbery right under the nose of Five-O.

A surprise birthday party for McGarrett ends with an attempt on his life. The attempt fails, but McGarrett is left blinded. Despite being incapacitated, it takes an order by the governor to stop him from searching for his assailant.

During the pursuit of an AWOL sailor, a fight ensues and one of two shore patrolmen is shot. But McGarrett and the Five-O team run into Navy resistance when they try to bring the suspect in under civil law to protect him.

A veteran of Vietnam has grave psychological problems which compel him to become a kidnapper. McGarrett is called into the kidnapping cases, and discovers that the young veteran is being driven into a catatonic state deliberately.
